summary: Iteration 15 audit fix verification (backend + frontend regression). Ran unit suite (28/28 pass) and 14 live backend integration tests (13/13 relevant passing; 1 real bug found in HR payroll list RBAC). Frontend smoke covered login, /hr/payroll, /admin/master employees (salary column), /finance/journals (doc_no shown, no UUIDs), inventory opname list, and market list.

critical.issue: Uses require_perm('hr.advance.approve') as single required permission. Spec/rbac_sync grants HR_OFFICER 'hr.payroll.read'+'hr.payroll.manage' but no 'hr.advance.approve', so HR_OFFICER gets 403 'Missing permission: hr.advance.approve' when listing payroll. Should be require_any_perm('hr.payroll.read','hr.advance.approve') to align with the salary-master pattern and the audit fix intent. File: backend/routers/hr.py lines 303, 314, 330.

action_items: Fix require_perm -> require_any_perm on GET /api/hr/payroll (list), GET /api/hr/payroll/{p_id}, GET /api/hr/payroll/export/xlsx in backend/routers/hr.py so HR_OFFICER (hr.payroll.read) can list/view payroll as intended by the audit fix. Currently only users with hr.advance.approve can even read the list, which contradicts rbac_sync grants and the request spec.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/hr.py: inconsistent RBAC — salary-master endpoints use require_any_perm('hr.payroll.read','hr.advance.approve') but payroll list/detail/export use require_perm('hr.advance.approve'). Please align.

rca of the issue: HR payroll list uses single permission require_perm('hr.advance.approve'). rbac_sync grants HR_OFFICER: ['hr.read','hr.payroll.read','hr.payroll.manage','hr.employee.read'] but not 'hr.advance.approve'. Login token embeds no perms directly (perms fetched per role at request time via get_user_permissions), and DB shows HR_OFFICER role has expected perms. Therefore mismatch is purely at the router dependency: change require_perm('hr.advance.approve') -> require_any_perm('hr.payroll.read','hr.advance.approve') on the three GET endpoints. Reproduction: login as hr.officer@fnbgroup.id then GET /api/hr/payroll → 403 with 'Missing permission: hr.advance.approve'. After fix expected: 200 with payroll list.
